responsibility: Defines the M32C family RTL machine-description patterns for integer add, subtract, negate, and absolute-value operations across QI/HI/PSI/SI modes, including separate expansions for 16-bit-address and 24-bit-address subtargets. It maps GCC arithmetic RTL onto target opcodes such as add/sub/adc/sbb/neg/abs, handles multiword SI sequences on A16 parts, specialized address arithmetic forms like mova and stack-pointer cases, and records flag behavior needed by later conditional code generation.
